name: proTES
description: A scalable GA4GH Task Execution Service API gateway for federating TES nodes across on-premise, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments.
shortDescription: Federate GA4GH TES nodes with configurable middleware, workload routing, and centralized request handling.
longDescription: proTES is a robust and scalable GA4GH Task Execution Service API gateway designed for federated compute networks. It provides a centralized entry point for independently operated TES instances while allowing configurable middleware to control request processing, workload distribution, validation, access control, and endpoint selection.
features: RabbitMQ and Celery for asynchronous task tracking
benefits: Connect independent compute environments through a single TES gateway
Route workloads according to infrastructure and data requirements
Add custom request and response processing through middleware
Support on-premise, hybrid, and multi-cloud deployments
Centralize authentication, routing, and telemetry capabilities

faq.question: What is proTES used for?
faq.answer: proTES acts as a gateway between clients and federated GA4GH TES instances, providing routing, middleware, authentication, and other centralized capabilities.

faq.question: Can proTES run across cloud and on-premise infrastructure?
faq.answer: Yes. proTES is designed to federate TES nodes across on-premise, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments.

faq.question: Can custom middleware be added?
faq.answer: Yes. Its plugin architecture allows developers to implement and inject middleware for use cases such as access control, validation, request processing, and endpoint selection.

seo.title: proTES - GA4GH TES API Gateway
seo.description: Federate GA4GH TES nodes across on-premise, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments with proTES.

name: TESK
description: A GA4GH Task Execution Service implementation that translates TES tasks into Kubernetes workloads.
shortDescription: Run GA4GH TES workloads on Kubernetes with task orchestration, storage management, and containerized execution.
longDescription: TESK is an implementation of the GA4GH Task Execution Service standard designed to execute computational tasks on Kubernetes. It exposes TES-compatible endpoints, translates incoming tasks into Kubernetes jobs, manages task-specific storage, and orchestrates executor pods throughout the task lifecycle.
features: Automatic translation of TES requests into Kubernetes jobs
benefits: Run TES workloads directly on Kubernetes infrastructure
Use containerized execution for reproducible workloads
Automatically manage task lifecycle and execution resources
Separate API, orchestration, storage, and executor responsibilities

faq.question: What does TESK do?
faq.answer: TESK implements the GA4GH TES standard and translates TES task requests into Kubernetes workloads for execution.

faq.question: What infrastructure does TESK require?
faq.answer: TESK is designed to run on Kubernetes. Workloads involving task input and output handling also require suitable Kubernetes storage.

faq.question: Can TESK run containerized workloads?
faq.answer: Yes. TESK executes task components as Kubernetes pods using container images.

seo.title: TESK - GA4GH Task Execution on Kubernetes
seo.description: Run GA4GH TES workloads on Kubernetes with TESK, a Kubernetes-based task execution engine.

shortDescription: Developer tooling for integrating license checks and compliance workflows into your development pipeline.
longDescription: License Chat CI is a developer-oriented service intended to help teams incorporate software license analysis and compliance checks into their development workflows.
benefits: Identify licensing issues earlier in development
Integrate compliance checks into CI workflows
Make licensing information easier for development teams to understand

faq.question: Who is License Chat CI for?
faq.answer: It is intended for software development teams that want to incorporate license analysis and compliance checks into their development or CI workflows.
